pages.title: Expression evaluation
pages.text:
Expression evaluation
x = 3
print(x**2 + 1) # 10
print((x + 1)**2) # 16
Exponentiation uses **. Parentheses determine which quantity is squared.

pages.title: A direct Python calculation
pages.text:
A direct Python calculation
elapsed_min = (time_seconds[-1]-time_seconds[0])/60
change_c = temperature_c[-1]-temperature_c[0]
rate_c_per_min = change_c/elapsed_min
A zero elapsed time would make the quotient undeﬁned. The denominator must be
checked before division.

pages.title: Scale in an error tolerance
pages.text:
Scale in an error tolerance
The absolute term controls comparisons near zero. The relative term scales with the
reference magnitude.
|60rs − rmin| ≤ 10−12
is a numerical unit-conversion check for this small example. It is not a statement about
thermometer accuracy.
Scientiﬁc Computing in Python Notes 13 / 15

pages.title: Plots and reproducible execution
pages.text:
Plots and reproducible execution
Five observations determine ﬁve plotted points. They do not determine the complete
function T (t).
If g(ti) = 0 at every sampled time, both T (t) and T (t) + g(t) ﬁt those
observations.
Scientiﬁc Computing in Python Notes 14 / 15
